about: In the heart of New York City, Bradley A. Sacks stands as a beacon of hope for those who have suffered due to the negligence or misconduct of others. As the founder of the Law Office of Bradley A. Sacks, he channels over 47 years of legal competence into a relentless pursuit of justice for his clients.

From medical malpractice to motor vehicle accidents, construction mishaps to civil rights violations, Mr. Sacks has built an impressive record of securing maximum compensation for his clients' damages. His journey began at Clark University and continued at Brooklyn Law School, culminating in admission to the New York State Bar Association in 1978 and later, the U.S. Supreme Court.

Before dedicating his career to representing individuals, Mr. Sacks honed his skills as assistant corporation counsel for New York City, defending the city in complex litigation. Since entering private practice in 1987, he has leveraged this experience to champion the rights of his clients throughout New York City and Long Island, providing personalized attention and unwavering support.

Beyond his legal practice, Mr. Sacks is deeply involved in the legal community, holding long-standing memberships in organizations such as the New York State Trial Lawyers Association and the New York County Lawyers Association. His commitment to service extends to volunteering with Trial Lawyers Care, assisting victims of 9/11, and serving as a diplomat for the American Board of Professional Liability Attorneys. He is not just an attorney; he is a dedicated advocate for justice and a pillar of support for those in need.
